primary_sources.title: A higher Gross-Zagier formula and the structure of Selmer groups
primary_sources.author: Chan-Ho Kim
primary_sources.verified_scope: Kolyvagin-system-theoretic structural refinement comparing Heegner-point Kolyvagin systems with Kurihara numbers and Selmer structure; arbitrary-rank arithmetic structure is downstream of discrete/Kolyvagin data and main-conjecture/nontriviality inputs rather than a theorem from exact complex Taylor order two.
primary_sources.strict_nonclaim: The source does not identify exact complex order two or L''(E,1) with the sharp Kolyvagin/Kurihara order required to turn Zhang's lower bound into exact Selmer rank.
